---
name: catalog-consistency
description: Audit Ventura Agents prompt files and README catalog for role overlap missing files inconsistent anatomy and unsupported claims. Use when adding removing renaming or materially changing an agent. Do not use when executing an existing agent on a business task.
---

# Catalog consistency

- Compare every catalog entry with its corresponding agent prompt file.
- Verify role function and primary deliverable agree between README and prompt.
- Detect agents that compete for the same primary request and sharpen or merge their boundaries.
- Keep the documented agent anatomy consistent across the collection where applicable.
- Verify tool suggestions are framed as optional integrations rather than assumed access.
- Remove affiliation certification or capability claims unsupported by repository evidence.
